descriptions.en: Fires three wind charges at you every 6 seconds.
descriptions.de: Schießt alle 6 Sekunden drei Windkugeln auf dich.
descriptions.es: Te dispara tres cargas de viento cada 6 segundos.
descriptions.fr: Te tire trois charges de vent dessus toutes les 6 secondes.
descriptions.ms: Menembak tiga cas angin ke arah anda setiap 6 saat.
descriptions.tr: Her 6 saniyede bir sana üç rüzgâr yükü fırlatır.
descriptions.zh: 每 6 秒向你发射三颗风弹。
